title: parasenecio hastatus var. chokaiensis
intro: Parasenecio hastatus var. chokaiensis, commonly known as Japanese wall lettuce, is a type of plant that belongs to the aster family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Japanese wall lettuce include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
